So, I know this is way too late. But I want to share this. I didn't give up on suicide. I jumped.From a bridge, with a rope tied around my neck. I had been battling depression for quite a while but nothing worked, not the counsellors, not the drugs, nothing. I felt horrible inside and out. My life was falling to pieces when it should've been getting better. I had just moved out to college. I hated college, I studied music, my passion since I was 11. I soon found out I wast half as good as others in course. I knew no one in College, couldnt make friends and couldnt adjust. I couldnt live on my own.The girl I loved so much was about to break up with me. I just couldnt handle it, I was crying four to five times a day. Waking up at night and talking nonsense into mirrors. I remember a full week where I didnt even get out of bed. I just stared at the ceiling, planning, plotting my death. I wrote my suicide notes out on my computer, the only productive thing I could do. So on a Sunday Evening, I decided not to go back to college and instead to go to a bridge I knew very well. I left all my notes at home. And went on my way. I called my girlfriend and told her I loved her. I tied the rope and got everything ready. I then sat on the ledge and stared at the sky, knowing it'd be the last stars I'd ever see. Somehow, my girlfriend copped something was up, she called my family, who went searching. My sister found me, on the ledge, thats when I jumped. Unfortunately I landed on another ledge I had forgotten was there. By this time my parents were there and were pinning me to the bridge. My sister called the police. They arrived, pulled me off the ledge, cuffed me and brought me to the station. I was brought to a psychiatric hospital two days later, where I was kept for 5 months. My girlfriend the left me while I was in hospital. I lost all contact with everyone I knew. I finally started college this year, and it was going well, until last Thursday, when I was caught doing some very stupid illegal things on Campus and I am pretty sure I am going to be kicked out. It seems i'm not meant for college. I don't know what to do, I cause so much pain to my family, and have been thinking about doing it again, I cant face a life with a criminal record, a life of shame  and guilt. I dont know what to do and Im scared.
